name: discord_create_channel
description: Create a channel in a guild. Provide `guild_id` and `name`; optional `type` (0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage, 15 forum), `topic`, `parent_id` (category to nest under), `position`, `nsfw`, `rate_limit_per_user` (slowmode seconds). Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS.

type.description: Channel type: 0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage, 15 forum. Defaults to 0.

parent_id.description: Category channel ID to nest this channel under.

rate_limit_per_user.description: Slowmode: seconds a user must wait between messages (0-21600).
